scripts.r2:create:dev: wrangler r2 bucket create pchat-dev-media --config wrangler.d1.json --env development --update-config=false
scripts.r2:create:prod: wrangler r2 bucket create pchat-prod-media --config wrangler.d1.json --env production --update-config=false
scripts.r2:verify:dev: wrangler r2 bucket dev-url get pchat-dev-media --config wrangler.d1.json --env development && wrangler r2 bucket domain list pchat-dev-media --config wrangler.d1.json --env development
scripts.r2:verify:prod: wrangler r2 bucket dev-url get pchat-prod-media --config wrangler.d1.json --env production && wrangler r2 bucket domain list pchat-prod-media --config wrangler.d1.json --env production
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply pchat-dev --config wrangler.d1.json --env development --local
scripts.d1:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply pchat-dev --config wrangler.d1.json --env development --remote
scripts.d1:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply pchat-prod --config wrangler.d1.json --env production --remote
scripts.d1:verify:dev: wrangler d1 execute pchat-dev --config wrangler.d1.json --env development --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('users','chats','members','messages','attachments') ORDER BY name"
scripts.d1:verify:prod: wrangler d1 execute pchat-prod --config wrangler.d1.json --env production --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('users','chats','members','messages','attachments') ORDER BY name"
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build:worker && npm run d1:migrate:prod && npm run check:worker && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.d1.json --env production
scripts.preview:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply pchat-preview --config wrangler.preview.json --local
